fusions.name: Swarm off the Grille
fusions.desc: Shakes 4 locusts off your grille at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Stripped to the Frame
fusions.desc: The cloud strips the target as you pass through it. It deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloud in Convoy
fusions.desc: A cloud of locusts rides along with you for 10 seconds, and deals 3 damage every second to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Crop for Fuel
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
